title: Polling
name: polling
english: Load the data again after each interval until it says the work is done, waiting longer after each failure.

inputs.name: interval
inputs.sentence: How many milliseconds to wait between good answers.

inputs.name: isDone
inputs.sentence: Whether an answer means the work is finished.

inputs.name: maxFailures
inputs.sentence: How many failures in a row stop the polling.

outputs.name: nextDelay
outputs.sentence: How long to wait before the next load.

wraps.concept: refetchInterval (a number, or false when done), enabled, retry with exponential back-off
wraps.adapter: The nextDelay output is what refetchInterval answers; a finished or stopped poll answers false.

phrases: keep checking until it is done

signals.sentence: This function loads data on a timer by hand.
